description: hard_backstop (phase guard): a request estimated over the hard input limit after every other stage has all but the latest exchanges aged, reasoning included; one that still exceeds it ends the turn with context_exhausted before it is sent. It replaces the over-limit rule for Provider-reported input.

exact_tail_exchanges.description: The latest exchanges the backstop keeps exact; at most exchange_aging's exact tail.

trigger_ratio.description: The share of the hard input limit at or above which the backstop ages, by the request's own estimate after every other stage (management v6: L6's emergency_fallback_ratio); absent: only a request over the hard limit.

aging.description: own: the backstop keeps and renders its own aged frontier, in a scheme without exchange_aging and reasoning_replay (management v6): the reasoning, read-only tool results and tool-returned images of every exchange before its exact tail age, the open ActionStep's included; absent: it moves the exchange stages' frontiers (v9, v10).
